hints.title: Common Multiple Equivalence
hints.text: Observe that if two numbers have their least common multiple within threshold, any shared multiple bridges them into one component.

hints.title: Harmonic Sieve Traversal
hints.text: For each number at most threshold, union it with all its multiples up to threshold using a disjoint-set data structure.

hints.title: Unique Component Counting
hints.text: Count how many unique root representatives are formed across all elements of nums.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: threshold: upper bound for least common multiple
complexity.notes: Unions each number with its multiples up to threshold using disjoint-set union.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise lcm calculation takes quadratic O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(threshold + n) memory for DSU parent mapping.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that numbers sharing a common multiple up to threshold form connected components.
